name: hcapp_setMultiRunRsvpAndCheckin
description: Processes the multi-run check-in dialog result in a single transaction. For each event in @checkInEventIds, upserts HasherEventMap with AttendenceState=20 (at hash) and RsvpState=3 (RSVP yes), guarded so existing check-ins (AttendenceState >= 20) are never downgraded. For each event in @rsvpNoEventIds, upserts HasherEventMap with RsvpState=1 (not coming), guarded so rows where the hasher is already checked in are not touched. Both lists are pipe-delimited UUID strings. After the transaction, runs HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser for check-in events, then delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData (common domain) to replicate attendance changes back to the device.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth (SP number 93, auth errorCode range 1193/1393) and forwarded to hcapp_syncUserData.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret. @param = NULL (device-secret-only auth). Also forwarded to hcapp_syncUserData.

parameters.name: checkInEventIds
parameters.description: Pipe-delimited list of event UUIDs to check in to (AttendenceState=20, RsvpState=3). Pass an empty string or NULL to skip check-in processing. UUIDs are TRIM()ed before CAST.

parameters.name: rsvpNoEventIds
parameters.description: Pipe-delimited list of event UUIDs to mark RSVP No (RsvpState=1). Pass an empty string or NULL to skip RSVP-No processing. Never downgrades existing check-ins.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: Target hasher to check in or RSVP for. If NULL, defaults to the authenticated user (@userId resolved from auth). Allows admins to act on behalf of other hashers.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark forwarded to hcapp_syncUserData for the HasherEventMap rowset. Pass 'ignore' to skip that domain. NULL is COALESCE'd to 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark forwarded to hcapp_syncUserData for the HasherKennelMap rowset. Pass 'ignore' to skip that domain. NULL is COALESCE'd to 'ignore'.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always returned as rowset 0. success=0 on auth failure or unhandled error; success=1 on success.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. Auth error codes (1193/1393) or CATCH error code (1993).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 1=auth, 3=device not found, 19=unhandled CATCH error.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned at rowset 1 when success=0. Standard HC6 app error shape. Mutually exclusive with AdHocData and sync rowsets.

rowsets.name: AdHocData
rowsets.description: Returned at rowset 1 when success=1. Minimal confirmation token per the adHocDataId pattern. Mutually exclusive with ErrorDetail rowset.

columns.name: adHocDataId
columns.description: Always 1. Sentinel value confirming successful write. Clients should check rowset 0 success=1 rather than inspecting this value.

rowsets.name: SyncUserDataRowsets
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ are the output of HC6.hcapp_syncUserData (common domain) called with @hashersUpdatedAfter='ignore', the caller-supplied HEM and HKM watermarks. The exact rowset count and shapes match hcapp_syncUserData's contract. Only present when success=1.

sideEffects: Upserts HC.HasherEventMap rows for all event UUIDs in @checkInEventIds (AttendenceState=20, RsvpState=3). Guard: never downgrades AttendenceState >= 20.
Upserts HC.HasherEventMap rows for all event UUIDs in @rsvpNoEventIds (RsvpState=1). Guard: never touches rows where AttendenceState >= 20.

Calls HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser(@hasherId) after commit if @checkInEventIds is non-empty — best-effort, wrapped in TRY/CATCH so a failure logs to HC.ErrorLog but does not surface as a SP error.
Calls HC6.hcapp_syncUserData with common-domain watermarks to return updated HEM and HKM data.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth failure (via ValidateAppAuth) and on CATCH error.

codeSmells.detail: The CATCH block uses errorType=19, which is not in the standard HC6 errorType table (valid codes are 1=auth, 2=validation, 3=not found, 4=concurrent modification, 5=unhandled DB error). Callers that branch on errorType=5 for unhandled errors will not catch this case.

codeSmells.issue: No validation on empty or malformed event UUID strings
codeSmells.detail: STRING_SPLIT + CAST(TRIM(s.value) AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) will throw an exception (caught by TRY/CATCH) if any pipe-delimited segment is not a valid UUID. The error message will be a raw SQL CAST failure with no indication of which event ID was malformed. Client-side validation is the only guard.

codeSmells.issue: updatedAt set with GETDATE() instead of SYSUTCDATETIME()
codeSmells.detail: HasherEventMap upserts set updatedAt = GETDATE() (local server time). Other SPs in the codebase use SYSUTCDATETIME() for UTC consistency. The UpdatedAt trigger on HasherEventMap will override this value on INSERT/UPDATE, so the final stored value is trigger-computed — but the GETDATE() in the MERGE is redundant and potentially misleading.

breakingChanges: Pipe delimiter (|) for event UUID lists is project-standard. Callers must never use comma-delimited lists.
hcapp_syncUserData is called with @hashersUpdatedAfter='ignore' hardcoded — the Hashers rowset is never included in the sync response from this SP regardless of what callers pass.
The CATCH block uses errorType=19 (non-standard). Callers should treat any success=0 at rowset 0 as an error regardless of errorType value.
